name: Jiaoyang Buzai De Jiuyue
source: Every year, on the third Saturday of September, the air-raid sirens are sounded in the City named Flowers. On this day in 2012, a crisis seems to be brewing in the city, and a series of stories affecting the fate of several students in the City unfold ...
translation: 每年九月的第三个星期六，这座名为“花之城”的地方都会拉响防空警报。2012年的这一天，一场危机似乎正在城市中酝酿，一系列影响城市中几名学生命运的故事正在展开……
